text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle Series
with Mejiro Palmer came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She performed reasonably well, and it seemed like
she had no lingering regrets, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Not yetâthere's still something I haven't done!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I just have to do this!
I absolutely must!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Repaying my bestie!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's main race is a 1400m GII.
The stands were buzzing with excitement over Mejiro Palmer's unexpected entry.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, what's up?
You're running in a sprint... or something!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I've always pushed Helios too hard, right?
Just so the two of us could front-run at a blistering pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So this time, I thought I'd jump into the sprint division
and help Helios out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, today is prep for that.
I'll put up great results here and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Next, the two of us will pull off an explosive front-running sprint! That's the plan☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Besties...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
K! If that's the case, I'll keep my hopes up.
The awakening of a new talent, whoo~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Trainer. Thanks for
going along with my crazy training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: To repay that kindness, I'm definitely gonna run my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... it can't just be about my own dream.
That just doesn't bring enough vibes!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Helios worked so hard for me—
I want to give back even more than she gave.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Today is that first step. So—!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uryaaaaah!
Here goes the ultimate runaway leeeeaaad!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aparapa, parapa~☆
I can't... get away at all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The hardcore sprinters are way too fast~!
What is this insane dash power~...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Palmer-san, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks, Flower.
You came in 3rd, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Can I call you Flower-senpai
starting today?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh... Um... That can't be...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bestieee, wasn't that move way too impossible after all? But still...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy♪
The crowd is totally loving it too☆"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, then I guess it wasn't
a complete waste of time. Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, taking on challenges is important.
Yeah, taking on challenges is important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The results didn't follow, but
even so, it added another fun memory to cherish.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin, if we're gonna do a double runaway lead, shouldn't we do it where we're both good at? Like 1800m☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally!
Let's keep carving out our legends!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bestie duo is forever! Facts☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them run together forever
at the head of the pack. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each time, the crowd goes wild.
The party never ends.
